fieldValues.title: Without its own tools, a group hands its meaning to AI
fieldValues.statement: A group can only own its meaning if it has the tools to hold, change and decide it. Without them it gives that ability up, and AI takes over: what the agents produce becomes what the group means, by default rather than by decision. This is the foundation problem of the domain; the others are ways it shows.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: reviewing the Group meaning ownership personas
